rewardDesign.name: Amber Signal Cap
rewardDesign.story: A cyan beacon on an amber cap marks the pilot who checks each hypothetical trial against measured evidence.

successorContract.title: Verify held-joint behavior in a bounded base-wave preview
successorContract.objective: Use a fresh measured observation as the simulation start, then check a small candidate base-wave sequence while holding shoulder, elbow, and gripper constant. This is a hypothetical preview only.
acceptance: Use no more than ten finite targets within illustrative simulation bounds.
Verify shoulder, elbow and gripper remain unchanged at every sampled preview step.
Verify the preview reaches each requested base endpoint and is labeled simulation-only.
Make no controller, serial, camera or physical movement requests.
successorContract.evidence: Provide passing simulation tests with starting observation source and timestamp, target sequence, per-step held-joint checks and endpoint checks.

rewardDesign.name: Docklight Meridian Crown
rewardDesign.story: A low-profile copper survey cap with a pale crown, a blue rearward marker, and an amber beacon. It marks a worker whose accepted reward is projected into their inventory and stays attached to the animated astronaut head.

successorContract.title: Replay RoArm joint fixtures and verify freshness transitions
successorContract.objective: Using a clearly labeled deterministic synthetic joint trace, and optional provided numeric measured samples only when source, units and timestamps are documented, verify documented forward-kinematics wrist pose within a declared tolerance and that stale samples cannot be shown as current. Use only the existing read-only observation path; do not issue motion commands or save camera frames.
acceptance: Trace input, provenance, units, timestamp basis and tolerance are explicit; malformed, future, out-of-order and stale samples have deterministic outcomes.
Synthetic replay reproduces expected wrist coordinates within declared tolerance; measured provenance stays distinct.
Tests demonstrate stale-to-fresh recovery without claiming stale data is current.
No motion, reset, home or camera-frame persistence.
Independent review checks provenance, tolerance, tests, unsupported cases and scoped diff.
successorContract.evidence: Provide source and units, replay expected/observed coordinates and residual, valid/malformed/stale/future/out-of-order/recovery tests, diff showing no motion or camera-frame writes, and independent review receipt.

rewardDesign.name: Ledger Halo Crown
rewardDesign.story: Twin tilted halos carry the beacon from one owner to the next, honoring an evidence trail that survives each accepted RoArm contract handoff.

successorContract.title: Verify joint observation provenance and restart lineage
successorContract.objective: Use deterministic fixtures and the existing read-only observation path to check joint source, timestamp, units and process lineage across a simulated controller restart. Compare joint vectors with declared tolerance and verify stale or out-of-order samples cannot appear current. Do not restart the real controller, connect hardware or issue motion.
acceptance: Record source, timestamp, units, joint vector and process/session identifier per fixture.
Declare per-joint tolerances and compare expected/observed vectors and residuals across simulated restart.
Malformed, future, out-of-order and stale samples cannot be labeled current.
Fresh post-restart fixture restores status without obsolete process/session identity.
Use deterministic fixtures only; no camera frames or physical movement.
successorContract.evidence: Fixture inputs/expected transitions, observed provenance and lineage, per-joint residuals and passing rejection/recovery tests.
